title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Agreement Terms: Renewal, Non-Renewal Notice and Renewal Rate
content:
## Article 1. Automatic renewal

At the end of a term an agreement whose automatic renewal is on renews for the tier's renewal term unless a signed non-renewal notice stands.

## Article 2. Non-renewal notice

2.1 A non-renewal notice stops the next renewal only when it is received no later than the tier's notice days in calendar days before the current term ends.

2.2 The notice deadline is the term end date less the notice days in calendar days, and a notice received on the deadline itself is timely. The clock is anchored on the term end date shown on the agreement's system record.

2.3 A non-renewal notice received after the deadline does not stop the coming renewal; it is recorded with a termination effective date equal to the end of the renewal term that follows. A timely non-renewal notice carries a termination effective date equal to the current term end date and no fee.

2.4 Boundary cases (hypothetical term end 2025-12-31, 60 notice days): the deadline is 2025-11-01. A notice received on 2025-11-01 is timely and ends the agreement on 2025-12-31; one received on 2025-11-02 is late, the agreement renews, and the notice takes effect at the end of that renewal term.

## Article 3. The renewal term

3.1 The renewal term starts the day after the expiring term end date.

3.2 The clause "Its per-seat rate is the expiring per-seat rate increased by the renewal uplift cap percent, rounded half up to the cent, unless the tier's current list fee per seat reduced by its term discount for the renewal term length is lower, in which case the lower rate applies" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every renewal. It no longer governs an automatic renewal, meaning an agreement whose automatic renewal is on rolling into its renewal term at term end, which follows the renewal pricing schedule. A renewal under a signed renewal on an agreement whose automatic renewal is off keeps this rate: the expiring per-seat rate increased by the renewal uplift cap percent, rounded half up to the cent, unless the tier's current list fee per seat reduced by its term discount for the renewal term length is lower, in which case the lower rate applies.

3.3 Its contracted seats equal the covered seats on the expiring term end date, but never less than the tier's minimum seats.

3.4 A renewal may be recorded only while the agreement status is active or suspended.

## Article 4. No renewal

An agreement whose automatic renewal is off and that has no signed renewal on file does not renew; at its term end it moves to the transition-out.

**Hypothetical illustration of 3.2 as it still applies.** A signed renewal of an agreement with automatic renewal off, expiring rate 120.00, cap 5 percent: the uplifted rate is 126.00. If the tier's current list fee reduced by its renewal-length discount were 124.00, the renewal rate would be 124.00; if it were 130.00, the rate would be 126.00. All figures are ClearPath Managed IT Services examples only.
